selection_rule: First two different-source tasks in admitted JN0 frozen plan; no outcome selection
watchdog_reason: Unchanged 30-second transport timeout permits at most 18*30=540 seconds waiting in a remote job; 1800 seconds adds margin for checkpoint IO and solver work. Same thresholds for all methods, only checked at durable boundaries; no hard real-time claim.
retry_policy: No automatic/manual retry, no extra probes, unknown send stops batch
pilot: First task all three jobs; standard validation and explicit continuation before task two
stop_policy: On interface/unknown/commit/metric/recovery/watchdog/cancel error preserve all remaining NOT_RUN; no source edits or new plan rerun during frozen batch
